errors.text_span: 该饼图显示了与“的”结构相关的各种组合式结构的分布情况。该图表总共包含四个切片。
errors.evidence: The figure contains two distinct pie charts, not a single one. Describing it as one chart with four slices misrepresents its hierarchical structure, where the right chart is a breakdown of a slice from the left chart.
The label for the yellow slice is “的”字只现不隐 ('de' character only appears, not hidden), which is the opposite of the description's “的”字只隐藏 ('de' character only hidden).

The label for the green slice is “的”字只隐不现 ('de' character only hidden, not appearing). The description “的”字只隐现 ('de' character only hidden and appearing) is an incorrect and confusing summary of the actual label.

errors.text_span: 切片按照从大到小的顺序排列，黄色切片最大，绿色切片最小。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly imposes a single sorting order on slices from two different charts. The slices are only sorted within their respective charts, not relative to each other across the entire figure.
The description omits the main title of the figure, which is "组合式“a的n”结构" (Combinatorial "a de n" structure).

The description fails to mention the hierarchical relationship between the two charts, indicated by the lines connecting the blue slice of the left chart to the entire right chart. This is a critical structural feature of the visualization.
